boundaries: Canonical categories have one value authority. Generated read schemas are separate from strict write schemas and can represent unsupported strings safely; no raw future value is coerced to a known successful state.

Backup/restore status columns and v1 wire fields stay open. Known running plus historical in_progress are recognized; missing or future values become neutral unknown in views. No new database CHECK or migration silently rejects historical rows.

Kubernetes resource kinds, volume phases, provider/distribution names, product-bridge extension maps and diagnostic details stay open where upstream owns their vocabulary. DeliveryPhaseBadge now maps unrecognized labels to neutral styling rather than pending/success. Such open strings never narrow to closed domain unions via a double assertion.

Charlie central approval rejected/dispatched is distinct from product-bridge summary denied. Onboarding central six-state lifecycle remains distinct from the bridge two-state proof. They have separate canonical identities; no blind union or coercion equates them.

Operational rollout controls are sourced from control.go actionTransition; scheduler state transitions differ deliberately. Draft/rolling_back/rollback_failed expose no operational controls; resolving permits pause in the control writer.

Ancillary existing closed inline OpenAPI enums and database constraints remain authoritative in their existing domains; inventory does not claim they were rewritten into the 41 focused category schemas.

No migration073 required: all retained rollout cluster terminal values already exist in production CHECK sets. Dedicated real database proof is baseline71; pending W09 migration072 and final canonical schema72 are separate combined integration gates.
